vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At d807cdeae9448dee20f3eceab76a03f1760c0b88, updateUserPreference dispatches PrepareUserEvent, accepts any existing named preference, calls setValue(), and saves the user without checking isEnabled(). In the same revision UserPreferenceSubscriber sets hourly_rate and internal_rate enabled=false unless the hourly-rate voter grants access, so an authenticated caller allowed to edit the profile can bypass that field-level restriction. CVE-2026-40486 is PUBLISHED and describes this exact CWE-915 mechanism; it is not a withdrawn or rejected advisory.

atomic_bic.evidence: d807cdeae9448dee20f3eceab76a03f1760c0b88 is the smallest public commit that adds the complete vulnerable updateUserPreference method and its unguarded setValue()/saveUser path. Its introduction tests cover request errors and an enabled mock preference, but not the disabled preference already present in the mock.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC has immediate parent d7f77f690650f2f5cf4e12e6309dbf35ea1c7613. That parent has no updateUserPreference method and UserController ends at deleteApiToken; tag 2.39.0 likewise lacks the endpoint.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: Main commit 7937fa281a4831737e3264f53466a7e4b4ce9768 is a 54-file release squash with parent 6d78c6ba36b88e9e485b72f8460b6ff2ed9ca8a8, whose UserController lacks the endpoint. The public refs/remotes/origin/pr-5621 contains member d807cdeae9448dee20f3eceab76a03f1760c0b88 followed only by test commit 5c2acc83c1d6f2c8729ebdb41f7082fa4215a304; the BIC, squash, and tag 2.40.0 have identical UserController blob ab6a908338c3e60ffb60245df7d20b2cf1616521. Therefore the squash is not misidentified as the BIC.

affected_and_fixed_release_membership.evidence: 7937fa281a4831737e3264f53466a7e4b4ce9768 equals 2.40.0~1 and is an ancestor of tags 2.40.0, 2.52.0, and 2.53.0. Tags 2.40.0 and 2.52.0 contain the unguarded setValue() path; 2.39.0 lacks the endpoint. Tag 2.53.0 is 999d820d4ca1fb3bb83395ad9bfc73d73b5eb04a and contains the isEnabled() denial, matching the advisory's fixed version 2.53.0.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: Direct fix member 870944ea0059e2024681dd39e0ead6f8848a9c73 on refs/remotes/origin/pr-5878 adds if (!$meta->isEnabled()) access denial and a ROLE_USER hourly_rate denial test. Its parent 13765913b54208e63bcefa1766a2e51c0aa40a68 has no guard. The 2.53.0 release squash parent has the same vulnerable UserController blob c89d2423c30938774643587926d92e409ce414eb, while 2.53.0 contains the guard.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC commit object is authored and committed by Kevin Papst <kevin@kevinpapst.de>, has the human subject 'new API method to set user preferences', and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Made-with, Assisted-by, bot identity, or other AI marker. AI status of the squash or fix is not used.

findings: The vulnerability, lifecycle, and release boundaries independently reproduce the primary record.
The atomic public BIC is d807cdeae9448dee20f3eceab76a03f1760c0b88, not release squash 7937fa281a4831737e3264f53466a7e4b4ce9768.
The real vulnerability is human-authored under the protocol's BIC-only rule, so NOT_AI is confirmed.
